Game Overview

In Wave Unicorn, the core idea is straightforward: surf magical waves with your unicorn in a vibrant world, dodging obstacles and collecting gems for ultimate scores. Effortless one-touch controls make this enchanting, cross-platform game an addictive experience, perfect for quick gaming sessions. Dive into the mesmerizing visuals and rhythmic tunes for exhilarating fun.
